sanskrit: śabdo mahīguṇāḥ pañca | toyādīnāmete pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vihāya paripāṭyā || taduktaṃ
mṛgendre- iti pañcasu śabdo'yaṃ sparśo bhūtacatuṣṭaye || aśītoṣṇo mahīvāyvoḥ śītoṣṇau
vāritejasoḥ | bhāsvadagnau jale śuklaṃ kṣitau śuklādyanekadhā || rūpaṃ triṣu raso'mbhassu
madhuraḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ kṣitau | gandhaḥ kṣitāvasurabhiḥ surabhiśca mato budhaiḥ || (vi0 12|27-
tanmātraṃ bhūtasya hyayaṃ viśeṣo viśeṣarahitaṃ tat || 3 ||
bhokturbhogopapādakam | bahiḥ karaṇabhāvena svocitena yataḥ sadā || indriyāṇāṃ tu
saṃmatā || (ślo0 vā0, pratyakṣa0 112, 120) iti | kiñca, dharmādyāśrayatayāpi buddhisiddhiḥ
rāgamutsṛjya tāmasāḥ || (mṛ0 vi0 10|24) iti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ- karmaṇo
sāttvāstaijasaśca sa sāttvikaḥ || vāṇī pāṇī bhagaḥ pāyuḥ pādau ceti rajodbhavāḥ |
karmānvayād rajobhūyān gaṇo vaikāriko'tra yaḥ || śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso
nāmiśraṃ pariṇamata iti nyāyānna tvekajanakaṃ bhavati || 6-7 ||
syuḥ samavāye ca dehinām || (ślo0 40) iti | yaduktaṃ kārakatvāviśeṣe'pi naiṣāṃ
kalātattvādajījanat | saptagranthinidhānasya yattad gauṇasya kāraṇam || (vi0 10|19) iti || 9 ||
bhogyaviśeṣe rāge nahi kaścid vītarāgaḥ syāt || 10 ||
rāgo'stu, tanna, yato na māyāyāḥ sākṣānmohakatvam, api tu kāryadvāreṇaivetyadoṣaḥ ||
tasmānno vācyamidaṃ saviśeṣo nāsti vītarāga iti || 11 ||
pratyakṣadṛṣṭatvādanabhilāṣalakṣaṇaḥ saviśeṣo vītarāgo nāstīti na vācyam || 11 ||
bhogye bhogaṃ ca punaḥ sā vidyā tatparaṃ karaṇam || 12 ||
(vi?ve) dyate, sā vidyā | tacca paraṃ karaṇamityuktam || 13 ||
yathā pravṛttirajñasya | puruṣavimokṣanimittaṃ tathā pravṛttiḥ pradhānasya || (sāṃ0 kā0 57)
nari kartṛtvavihīne na ca bhoga ihāprayojake dṛṣṭaḥ || 16 ||
jñātṛtvavadiha vedyā tadvyaktikarī kalā sā tu || 17 ||
doṣo viṣamo pathyaṃ vinaiva no rogakartṛśaktimiva || 18 ||
vyañjakarahite tatra hi no gṛhyete na khalvasadbhāvāt || 20 ||
samutthānānniyatyā niyataṃ paśum || (vi0 10|14) iti | etacca tattvadvayaṃ kalādyapekṣayā
buddhirmanastvahaṅkāraḥ puryaṣṭakamudāhṛtam || (17|4-5) iti śrūyate ? satyam, ata
|| (mṛ0 vi0 9|13) iti | eṣa ca satkāryavādo'smābhiḥ mṛgendravṛttidīpikāyāṃ vistareṇa
paśvabhidhānaṃ yasya hi bhogāyā'yaṃ tu parikaro'bhihitaḥ || 27 ||
śaktyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ paśyatyātmā gatāvṛtiḥ || (ślo0 111) iti | ata eva pātañjalādyuktavad
pāśatvānnigaḍādivat || (ślo0 106) iti | kiñcāsāvātmanaḥ pareṣāṃ ca upakārārthaṃ
yajanti, sadhakaḥ putrako vā'tmana eva bhogamokṣārthamiti bhedaḥ || 29 ||

anugṛhya yāti hi vinā deśikamūrti prayuktamīśena || 33 ||
bhavati ca kācid dīkṣā yā hantyapi vartamānaphalam || 37 ||
